summary: Southern California Gas Company, an indirect subsidiary of Sempra, filed an 8-K to enter into an underwriting agreement for a registered public offering of $650 million aggregate principal amount of 5.900% First Mortgage Bonds, Series FFF, due 2056. The bonds are offered at 99.536% of par via a prospectus supplement under an effective shelf registration statement. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms such as premium, close date, or break fee are applicable.
